Defence Minister Rajnath Singh raised US military assistance to Pakistan during talks with US War Secretary Pete Hegseth in Cebu, Philippines. Later, while addressing ASEAN defence ministers and dialogue partners, Singh highlighted Operation Sindoor and offered India's battle-tested counter-terrorism expertise.
